guides.title: Connect a social account
guides.summary: Opens Connect account, picks the platform and what Rafii may do, then stops at the platform's sign-in, which the person completes themselves.

guides.title: Write a post with Rafii
guides.summary: Type an idea, choose accounts and language, then ask Rafii to draft one version per account.

guides.title: Schedule a draft
guides.summary: Open the Drafts tab, choose Schedule on a draft, pick the account and time, and prepare it for review.

guides.title: Review and approve a post
guides.summary: Find a post waiting for approval in the Queue, check it and approve it.

guides.title: Set up your writing voice
guides.summary: Add writing samples on Brand so Rafii learns how you write.

guides.title: Create an automation
guides.summary: Start a new automation: when Rafii drafts, which accounts, and who reviews.

guides.title: Upload an image to the Library
guides.summary: Add an image to the Library so it can be attached to posts.

guides.title: Turn on web search
guides.summary: On Memory, the workspace owner allows Rafii to search the web for current facts.

guides.title: Choose Rafii's writer
guides.summary: On Models & providers, pick which AI writer drafts your posts.

guides.title: Check your plan and credits
guides.summary: On Usage & plan, see what is left of each allowance, including media credits for images.
